title: Fresh Water Ecology
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a crucial link in the decomposition of organic matter and the cycling of nutrients in aquatic systems."
Heterotrophic bacteria are a crucial link in the decomposition of organic matter and the cycling of nutrients in aquatic systems.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important biological process on the planet, and its products drive the biological activity of nearly all ecosystems, including aquatic environments."
Photosynthesis is the most important biological process on the planet, and its products drive the biological activity of nearly all ecosystems, including aquatic environments.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the opposite of this, and spend much of their lives in the freshwater community."
Catadromous fish are the opposite of this, and spend much of their lives in the freshwater community.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of ecology which deals with fresh water ecosystems."
Fresh Water Ecology is a branch of ecology which deals with fresh water ecosystems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important food source in shallow, stony rivers with adequate light penetration."
Periphyton is an important food source in shallow, stony rivers with adequate light penetration.
